description: Bundled, offline OSV-style vulnerability feed. No network access. Records are illustrative fixtures keyed by ecosystem + package for deterministic local enrichment. Vulnerability IDs are only ever emitted from this feed, never invented.

vulnerabilities.summary: Prototype pollution in demo-vulnerable-package allows property injection.
vulnerabilities.details: Untrusted input passed to the merge helper can pollute Object.prototype, enabling denial of service and, in some configurations, remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.summary: requests session does not verify certificate after first request with verify=False reuse.
vulnerabilities.details: Under specific session reuse patterns the certificate verification setting may not be re-applied, weakening TLS guarantees.

vulnerabilities.summary: requests leaks Proxy-Authorization header on cross-origin redirect.
vulnerabilities.details: When following a redirect to a different host, the Proxy-Authorization header may be retained and sent to the new host.
